hooks.new: fun updateLocation(location: android.location.Location): Unit = updateLocation(location = MapLocation(coordinate = MapCoordinate(location.latitude, location.longitude), speed = location.speed.toDouble(), course = if (location.hasBearing()) location.bearing.toDouble() else -1.0, timestamp = Instant.ofEpochMilli(location.time)))
